name: pc.fact-consumer-profile.v1

wire.mapOrder: ascending unsigned integer keys; shortest encoding; all listed keys required

cose.container: tag18 COSE_Sign1 with exact embedded payload and P1363 signature

authorityRules: The installer pins the exact signed profile digest and issuer, environment, tenant, privacy, profile identity/revision, subscription, workload credential/epoch and database login. Public requests cannot supply installation authority.
The only admitted subscriptions are SUB-FACTCANDIDATEADMITTED-CONTROL_WORK-V1 for LS-CONTROL-WORK and SUB-FACTCANDIDATEADMITTED-FLEET_CONTROL-V1 for LS-FLEET-CONTROL.
Profile verification is not live workload authorization, mTLS authentication, effect authorization, source verification, an ACK or cursor advancement. Each effect rechecks its own authority.

maximumAttempts includes the first attempt. After failed attempt n the delay is min(maximumBackoffMs, initialBackoffMs * 2^(n-1)). Exhaustion quarantines the original identity with a safe problem and work item; it never marks delivery.
The finite numeric ceilings are implementation admission limits, not throughput or availability claims. Capacity refusal consumes no effect attempt and releases the lease without acknowledgement.

A retry at or after profile expiry is blocked pending valid installation authority. Installing a successor never resets consumed attempt count or replaces the original envelope/digest/business identity.
